可霖多多并不知上官程的身份，此刻却是真的慌了。她早适应了被这样针对，可上官程不同。他在霖多多眼中就是个小弟弟——敏感、脆弱，还没有学会怎么面对这个世界的恶意。

她完全出于本能挡在了上官程面前：“他更不可能做出那种事！”

“哟？这么肯定？”瞿爽抱着双臂，笑得不怀好意，“你很了解他吗？怎么之前从没听你提起过？我瞧着你们长得一丁点也不像。什么堂弟？怕不是你从哪偷来的男人，瞎编的身份吧？”

霖多多的语气罕见地带了情绪。她知道瞿爽这话是胡说八道的，是在故意刺激她，并非真的看出了什么。可她还是忍不住发慌。

因为上官程根本经不起查。

一旦让瞿爽发现他只是个机器人，不受法律保护，没有公民身份——她都不敢想会是什么下场。

上官程看着挡在自己身前的瘦小身影，眼眸微动。“别怕。”他轻声说道。“不会有事的。”

男人的声音很沉，很稳，霖多多原本慌乱的心蓦地就安了许多。

“霖多多，你这么信任你弟弟，敢让我搜一下吗？”瞿爽语气尖锐，咄咄逼人，“他要真是清白的，那就放心大胆让我搜一搜！”

霖多多并未起身，替上官程牢牢挡住瞿爽冷恶的视线。“他不喜欢被外人碰，你不能搜。”

“不喜欢别人碰？就不让搜？真够娇气的哈？”瞿爽娇柔一笑，让人起鸡皮疙瘩，“霖多多你可真搞笑啊。让我们相信他的清白，又不让证明。你这么护着他——根本就是心里有鬼吧！”

她的声音忽然冷了下来。

“我看那矿标啊，分明就在他身上。”

她死死瞪着上官程，那眼神就像看一只注定被宰的羔羊。

几十分钟前，她在上官程那里受到了侮辱，怀恨在心，发誓要报复回去。

她见霖多多埋头整理矿料，上官程又一副痴迷的模样望着霖多多。于是趁二人不注意，拿走了那几块矿标。

之后，她故意从上官程身旁路过，佯装愤怒地对他骂了几句，看似是在发泄，实则是趁机把那几块小矿标投进了他宽厚的上衣口袋中。

她亲手放进去的罪证，怎么可能逃得掉？

只要把那几块矿标搜出来，上官程就会被做实偷盗的罪名，到时候入了狱，以她瞿家的势力，还不是任由她折磨？最好在狱中弄瞎他这双眼，那才算是彻底出了心头恶气。

But Lin Duoduo didn't know Shangguan Cheng's identity, but he was really panicking at this moment.She had long been used to being targeted like this, but Shangguan Cheng was different.He is just a little brother in Lin Duoduo's eyes - sensitive, fragile, and has not yet learned how to face the malice of the world.

She stood in front of Shangguan Cheng out of complete instinct: "It's even more impossible for him to do that kind of thing!"

"Oh? So sure?" Qu Shuang crossed his arms and smiled maliciously, "Do you know him very well? Why have I never heard you mention it before? I see that you two look nothing alike. What kind of cousin? Isn't it a man you stole from somewhere and made up his identity?"

Lin Duoduo's tone was unusually emotional.She knew that Qu Shuang's words were nonsense and he was deliberately irritating her, not that he really saw anything.But she still couldn't help but panic.

Because Shangguan Cheng couldn't stand the investigation at all.

Once Qu Shuang found out that he was just a robot, without legal protection and without citizenship - she couldn't even imagine what would happen.

Shangguan Cheng looked at the thin figure standing in front of him, his eyes moving slightly."Don't be afraid," he said softly."It'll be okay."

The man's voice was deep and steady, and Lin Duoduo's originally panicked heart suddenly felt much more at ease.

"Lin Duoduo, you trust your brother so much, do you dare to let me search him?" Qu Shuang said in a sharp and aggressive tone, "If he is really innocent, then feel free to let me search him!"

Lin Duoduo didn't stand up, but blocked Qu Shuang's cold and evil sight for Shangguan Cheng."He doesn't like to be touched by outsiders, so you can't search him."

"You don't like others to touch you? You won't let them search you? Are you really squeamish?" Qu Shuang smiled softly, making people's skin crawl. "Lin Duoduo, you are so funny. You make us believe in his innocence, but you don't want to prove it. You are protecting him like this - you must have something secret in your heart!"

Her voice suddenly turned cold.

"Look at the mine mark, it's clearly on him."

She stared at Shangguan Cheng, her eyes like looking at a lamb destined to be slaughtered.

A few dozen minutes ago, she was insulted by Shangguan Cheng. She held a grudge and vowed to go back for revenge.

She saw Lin Duoduo immersed in sorting the mineral materials, and Shangguan Cheng looked at Lin Duoduo with an obsessed look.So when the two of them weren't paying attention, they took away the mineral markers.

Afterwards, she deliberately passed by Shangguan Cheng, pretending to be angry and scolding him a few words. It seemed she was venting her anger, but in fact she took the opportunity to throw the few small mining signs into his generous jacket pocket.

How could the incriminating evidence she put in with her own hands escape?

As long as those few mining signs are found, Shangguan Cheng will be convicted of theft and imprisoned. With the power of her Qu family, shouldn't she be tortured?It would be best to blind his eyes in prison, then he would be completely out of his mind.
